q: How many students are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students;

q: List all departments
sql: SELECT dept_name, dept_code FROM departments;

q: Show all CSE students
sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_code = 'CSE';

q: Top 5 students by average score
sql: SELECT s.name, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 5;

q: How many students passed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM marks WHERE score >= 40;

q: List courses with more than 3 credits
sql: SELECT course_name, credits FROM courses WHERE credits > 3;

q: Show students who failed in any course
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.score < 40;

q: Count students per department
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name;

q: Average score per course
sql: SELECT c.course_name, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM courses c JOIN marks m ON c.course_id = m.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC;

q: Show students with low attendance
sql: SELECT s.name, (a.attended * 100.0 / a.total_classes) AS attendance_pct FROM students s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id WHERE (a.attended * 100.0 / a.total_classes) < 75;

q: List fee defaulters
sql: SELECT s.name, f.amount, f.paid, f.status FROM students s JOIN fees f ON s.student_id = f.student_id WHERE f.status IN ('Unpaid', 'Partial');

q: Which students are in hostels?
sql: SELECT s.name, h.hostel_name FROM students s JOIN hostel_allotments ha ON s.student_id = ha.student_id JOIN hostels h ON ha.hostel_id = h.hostel_id;

q: Top 10 students from CSE who scored above 80
sql: SELECT s.name, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE d.dept_code = 'CSE' AND m.score > 80 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 10;

q: Show all club members and their clubs
sql: SELECT s.name, c.club_name, cm.role FROM students s JOIN club_members cm ON s.student_id = cm.student_id JOIN clubs c ON cm.club_id = c.club_id;

q: Find the highest scorer in each department
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, s.name, MAX(m.score) AS top_score FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name;

q: How many female students are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE gender = 'F';

q: Show courses offered by IT department
sql: SELECT c.course_name, c.credits FROM courses c JOIN departments d ON c.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_code = 'IT';

q: List students in their 3rd year
sql: SELECT name, dept_id FROM students WHERE year = 3;

q: Average attendance per course
sql: SELECT c.course_name, AVG(a.attended * 100.0 / a.total_classes) AS avg_attendance FROM courses c JOIN attendance a ON c.course_id = a.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name;

q: Which faculty are on leave?
sql: SELECT name, designation FROM faculty WHERE status = 'On-Leave';

q: Show students who scored an O grade
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id WHERE m.grade = 'O';

q: Count of students per hostel
sql: SELECT h.hostel_name, COUNT(ha.student_id) AS occupancy FROM hostels h JOIN hostel_allotments ha ON h.hostel_id = ha.hostel_id GROUP BY h.hostel_id, h.hostel_name;

q: Find departments with more than 20 students
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS cnt FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name HAVING COUNT(s.student_id) > 20;

q: Show elective courses
sql: SELECT course_name, credits FROM courses WHERE course_type = 'Elective';

q: Total fees collected per semester
sql: SELECT semester, SUM(paid) AS total_collected FROM fees GROUP BY semester ORDER BY semester;

q: List students who are club presidents
sql: SELECT s.name, c.club_name FROM students s JOIN club_members cm ON s.student_id = cm.student_id JOIN clubs c ON cm.club_id = c.club_id WHERE cm.role = 'President';

q: Show students with perfect attendance in any course
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN attendance a ON s.student_id = a.student_id WHERE a.attended = a.total_classes;

q: Top 3 courses by average score
sql: SELECT c.course_name, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM courses c JOIN marks m ON c.course_id = m.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 3;

q: How many students have unpaid fees?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM fees WHERE status = 'Unpaid';

q: Show marks for a specific student named Aarav Sharma
sql: SELECT c.course_name, m.score, m.grade FROM marks m JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.name = 'Aarav Sharma';

q: List all active clubs and their faculty advisors
sql: SELECT c.club_name, f.name AS advisor FROM clubs c JOIN faculty f ON c.faculty_id = f.faculty_id WHERE c.status = 'Active';

q: Find students who scored below 40 in DBMS
sql: SELECT s.name, m.score FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id JOIN courses c ON m.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'DBMS' AND m.score < 40;

q: Show average score of ME students
sql: SELECT AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_code = 'ME';

q: Count of male and female students
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM students GROUP BY gender;

q: Show hostel students who are also club members
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN hostel_allotments ha ON s.student_id = ha.student_id JOIN club_members cm ON s.student_id = cm.student_id;

q: List courses with zero failures
sql: SELECT c.course_name FROM courses c WHERE c.course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM marks WHERE score < 40);

q: Show all 4th year ECE students
sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_code = 'ECE' AND s.year = 4;

q: Top department by average marks
sql: SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 1;

q: Find students enrolled in more than 5 courses
sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) AS course_count FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.course_id) > 5;

q: Show semester-wise average score for CSE students
sql: SELECT m.semester, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.dept_code = 'CSE' GROUP BY m.semester ORDER BY m.semester;
